search.note: Keyless ('No API key … No account or authentication header is required'). location must be a Jobicy location slug (?get=locations lists them); there is no page parameter — count is the whole result set, so page > 1 repeats it. Jobicy asks that stored listings be re-checked only 'once or twice per hour'. An official MCP server also exists at https://jobicy.com/mcp.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none') and no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: Only the list endpoint (plus ?get=locations / ?get=industries) is documented; re-read the record from the search hit.
not_offered.apply: Page: 'Apply stays assist (url → Jobicy listing → employer)'.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the page documents job search, RSS and the value lists only.
